messages:
mia: quick accessibility heads-up from user testing — in the playground run history compact rows, the toolcard annotations lose an aria-label when collapsed. VoiceOver reads just 'button' which is confusing for people navigating results. alen: can you paste repro steps? I want to see if it's the editor side or run-history renderer. mia: repro: open playground > run history > pick a compact run > collapse the tool output panel (chevrons). VoiceOver focus lands on the chevron button but doesn't announce which tool or its output summary. sam: do we have a minimal DOM snapshot? even a snippet helps (would avoid a full repro flow). mia: sure — simplified: ```html
...
``` No aria-label on the button and we rely on surrounding text which gets visually hidden in compact mode. lisa: ok — two quick fixes: 1) add an explicit `aria-label` with the tool name + collapsed state, 2) ensure `aria-controls` points to the output region. Copywise I'd prefer short: `"Tool: {name}, collapsed"` vs `"Toggle tool output for {name}"` — opinions? sam: I vote for clarity over brevity here — screen reader users benefit from explicit verbs. `"Toggle tool output for {name}"` reads as an action so it's clear it's interactive. +1 for aria-controls. alen: agree with sam. also add visually-hidden text fallback so non-JS ATs get content. We should keep the run-history compact layout accessible without expanding each card. mia: sounds good. small nit on phrasing: avoid 'toggle' since the button also expands/collapses. Maybe `"Show tool output for {name}"` when collapsed and `"Hide tool output for {name}"` when expanded. That provides stateful context. lisa: yeah that pattern is nice — matches `aria-expanded` semantics. Add to the copy guide under Playground > Run History > Compact row patterns. I'll drop a short note in the figma file. @ui-bot can you link the figma frame? ui-bot: figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/playground-run-history-compact — frame: CompactRows/A11Y-nits sam: implementation plan: I can land a tiny patch — add aria-label state strings + aria-controls id. I'll also add a unit test in `run-history.test.tsx` asserting `button` has expected `aria-label` for collapsed & expanded states. alen: wrap it behind the `playground-accessibility` feature flag? we can roll to canary and verify with VoiceOver on mac before wide rollout. mia: yes let's feature-flag it. Also add an automated VoiceOver smoke test in our e2e a11y job (just check that the focusable chevron announces the label). lisa: copy for the guide (final): collapsed: `"Show tool output for {toolName}"`; expanded: `"Hide tool output for {toolName}"`. Sam/Alen/Mia to own PR + canary. I'll update figma and the copy doc. :thumbsup: sam: assigned — will send PR today and tag `#eng-qa` for canary validation. mia: thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. small changes like this make the playground much more usable. :heart:
